name: Big Ear radio telescope (Ohio State University Radio Observatory)
description: A Kraus-type radio telescope operated by Ohio State University for nearly 40 years; it ceased operation in late 1997 and was destroyed in early 1998 after the land was sold to developers. The memorial site is run by NAAPO, not by OSU.
highlights: On 15 August 1977 it recorded the Wow! signal, which lasted the full 72-second window; Jerry Ehman noticed it days later.
The signal came from near the globular cluster M55 in Sagittarius.
Held the Guinness record for the longest-running SETI project.
